title: Palm Creek Resort & Residences
gap: Price for 9 or 18 holes not stated
blurb: Guests can play on an executive-style Par 3 Championship Golf Course featuring well-manicured greens, lush fairways, two lakes, and a creek with mountain views. The course offers 9 or 18 hole rounds and has a full-service Pro Shop for golf apparel, equipment, and rentals. Detailed hole-by-hole videos and tips are available to help players master the course.
